data.title: FracPro Live+ Plots - Prepopulate Current Template Name in the Save Template Dialog for Existing Templates
data.description: As a Live+ user, I want the Save Template dialog to automatically populate the current template name, So that I can easily update or save an existing template without re-entering its name.

acceptance_criteria.text: Scenario 1: Existing Template Given the user has opened an existing template When the user clicks the Save Template button Then the Template Name field shall be automatically populated with the current template name. Scenario 2: Save Without Changing Name Given the Save Template dialog displays the current template name When the user clicks Save without modifying the name Then the existing template will give warning. save button gets disabled Scenario 3: Save With Updated Name Given the Save Template dialog displays the current template name When the user edits the template name and clicks Save Then the application shall save the template using the updated name And apply the existing template name validation rules.
